recipes.oracle_text:
Flying
{7}{U}: Adapt 4. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard. (If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put four +1/+1 counters on it.)

recipe_coverage: Pinned growth component with actual source casting, printed costs, both controllers, pending states, cleanup and replay. Mandatory monstrous companion effects have independent matching/nonmatching controller/type/subtype/indestructibility and survival/death controls. Explicit gaps: Flying; source keyword combat; control changes; multiplayer. Generic costs are recomputed from the controller's current matching graveyard cards at every actual payment; colored requirements remain. Mixed, nonmatching, opponent-only and zero/excess reductions are distinguished. Excess cases queue X0 or X3 sentinels and assert they remain unused because Oracle prints a fixed discounted cost; the X3 case independently requires all three extra generic mana to remain.
